messages:
omar_ops: FYI vendor updated allocation — 18 GPUs confirmed for our EU pool, but carrier is splitting into two shipments 3 days apart. Need customs docs and confirmation on partial acceptance.
vendor_contact_jp: Sorry for the split, that's the best ETA. Shipment A (12 units) ETA 2026-04-14, Shipment B (6 units) ETA 2026-04-17. We can include BOL and packing list for each.
jia_procurement: Thanks. Are the 2 units you flagged as DOA in last QC hold still being replaced under warranty or do we need to RMA separately?
vendor_contact_jp: We found 2 DOA during outbound check — we will replace under RMA. RMA ref: JP-RMA-99823. Replacements will go in Shipment B to avoid extra customs entries.
omar_ops: Noted. Important: can we get serials for both the replacements and the units in Shipment A? Need to pin them to rack assignments and firmware inventory.
vendor_contact_jp: Sending serials in a sec.
supply_bot: Carrier update: https://tracking.example.com/track/ZX9-4521 — provisional bill of lading uploaded.
vendor_contact_jp: BOL snippet:```
BOL: BL-20260412-88
Shipper: VendorCo JP
Consignee: Redwood Inference EU Warehouse (NL)
Items: 12x GPU-AXL-80, 6x GPU-AXL-80 (separate BOL)
Weight: 420kg
HTS: 8471.70.90
```
anna_pm: Quick question — if Shipment B contains the replacement units, do we have the capacity to stagger provisioning? We can't have half the cluster degraded for a week during the canary.
mike_infra: We can provision Shipment A immediately and hold nodes in standby mode. For canary, recommend reserving at least 4 units from A for the canary pool. The missing 2 DOA->replace shouldn't block deployment.
kelly_legal: Make sure customs paperwork includes our EORI and the commercial invoice shows warranty replacements as 'no commercial value' to avoid VAT. Share invoice draft and we'll review.
jia_procurement: Pricing note — vendor offered a 2% credit for the DOA occurrences on this batch. Need confirmation before invoice closes. Also vendor requests us to accept partial shipment terms in contract addendum (they referenced clause 5.2a).
omar_ops: I can accept partials for logistics reasons, but want clear SLAs for replacements (RMA turnaround <= 10 business days) and advance serials. Can vendor commit?
vendor_contact_jp: We commit to RMA turnaround 7-10 business days from clearance. We'll provide serials and per-unit firmware version in the manifest.
mike_infra: Please ensure replacement units are same FW major version or we need to schedule a mass firmware sync job.
vendor_contact_jp: Understood — all units shipped will be on v2.3.1 or higher.
kelly_legal: Jia/legal will need the addendum text. Jia, can you confirm if 2% credit language is acceptable?
jia_procurement: 2% is fine as long as it applies to the affected invoice line items and there's a short memo on the credit purpose. I'll draft an email to vendor.
supply_bot: RMA case created: #JP-RMA-99823. Carrier pickup for Shipment A scheduled 2026-04-12 18:00 JST.
omar_ops: Action items: 1) Jia to get addendum & credit confirmation, 2) Vendor to upload serial manifest and per-shipment BOLs, 3) Kelly to check VAT wording, 4) Mike to prepare provisioning plan reserving 4 GPUs.
jia_procurement: I'll send draft addendum and confirm 2% credit by EOD (our time).
vendor_contact_jp: Manifest uploaded: https://vendor.example.com/manifests/JP-99823-manifest.csv (contains serials, FW). Will attach BOLs to the manifest.
mike_infra: Got the manifest. Minor mismatch on one serial (GPU-AXL-80-SN-4721 vs SN-4722). Vendor, can you re-confirm SN list before carrier departure?
vendor_contact_jp: Checking now — likely a typo on our side. Will correct and re-upload in 15m.
omar_ops: Thanks. Also tagging ops-oncall for customs clearance window: @kelly_legal and @jia_procurement please confirm customs broker and HS code handling.
kelly_legal: Confirming we use TrustedBroker EU. Jia, please include broker contact on the perm clearing docs.
jia_procurement: Will do.
vendor_contact_jp: Re-uploaded manifest with corrected serials. File: JP-99823-manifest_v2.csv
omar_ops: All good. One more ask — if any units are DOA on arrival, please notify via Slack and raise RMA priority to 'expedite' so we can get swap stock.
vendor_contact_jp: Will do.
supply_bot: Update: Shipment A cleared customs, ETA consolidation to our NL warehouse 2026-04-14 09:00 CEST. Shipment B still pending export docs.
anna_pm: Great. Thanks everyone — i'll update the release calendar to avoid the canary overlap. :white_check_mark:
omar_ops: Closing loop: Please keep thread updated as BOLs and manifests finalize. :thumbsup:
